registry_policy: Catalog metadata is distinct from an acquisition receipt. A source cannot enter an evidence calculation until an acquisition receipt records retrieved_at and the SHA-256 of the exact raw artifact.

sources.title: HHS Unaccompanied Alien Children Program
sources.known_scope: Daily aggregate custody and discharge measures; not child-level records or post-release safety outcomes.

sources.title: Workload and Adjudication Statistics — Unaccompanied Alien Children
sources.known_scope: Published case-process statistics; not a direct measure of child location or welfare.

sources.title: DHS OIG-24-46
sources.known_scope: Audit findings and disclosed administrative counts; keep sample estimates, population counts, and operational events distinct.

sources.title: DHS OIG-25-21
sources.known_scope: ICE-focused audit; HHS source data and end-to-end cross-agency linkage were outside audit scope.

sources.title: Unaccompanied Children: Efforts by ORR to Address GAO Recommendations

sources.title: Unaccompanied Children: HHS Can Take Further Actions to Monitor Their Care

sources.known_scope: EOIR court-case stock by pending-duration bands; excludes Franco/mental competency, Institutional Hearing Program, MPP, and 7A-adjourned cases; not a child-location or welfare measure.

sources.title: Unaccompanied Alien Child Statistics
sources.known_scope: I-862 initial case completions only; in-absentia removals are a subset of removals; excludes Franco/mental competency, Institutional Hearing Program, MPP, and 7A-adjourned cases.
